tools.name: game
tools.description: Everything on one Roblox game right now: players now and its place on Roblox, the change over 1 and 24 hours, highs (24 hours, 14 days, since tracking began on Sep 27 2026), momentum and 7-day average, its genre and its place in it, its developer and the people behind it, its latest updates with how

tools.name: days
tools.description: One game’s players day by day (New York days, newest first): the average, peak and low, visits that day, and what happened (updates, events). Free shows the last 7 days; Pro shows every day since tracking began on Sep 27 2026 (up to 60).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Roblox games by name: up to 8 matches with their universe id, developer, genre and players now, the most played first.

tools.name: rising
tools.description: The Roblox games gaining players fastest, against a day ago (range 24h) or a week ago (range 7d), each with its players now and then, the change, genre, when it came out and a line of its players. Optionally one genre.

tools.name: top
tools.description: A ranked list of Roblox games now. most_played: the most players right now. new: the most played games that came out in the last 30 days. Optionally one genre.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: What developers are making games about: the words in new games’ names, by how many new games used them in the last 30 days against the 30 before, with the biggest game for each. With a word (like horror or brainrot), just that one: use it to check whether an idea has been done and how it’s doing.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Two to five Roblox games side by side now: players, change over 24 hours, momentum, genre place, latest update and its result, and a 7-day line of each one’s players.

tools.name: studio
tools.description: A developer (a Roblox group or one person) and the games they make, by one of their games or by name: who owns it, members, verified, their place among developers, players in all their games now, and each game with players now, visits and likes.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Screen the 600 most played Roblox games by their numbers: genre, a theme they’re about (a word in their names and descriptions, like horror, anime or tycoon), players now, change over 24 hours or 7 days, age and likes, sorted by what you pick.

tools.name: roblox
tools.description: Players online across all of Roblox right now, the change on a day ago and on a week ago.

tools.name: genres
tools.description: Every genre on Roblox now: players, its share of everyone playing, the change on a day ago, how many games, its subgenres and its biggest games.

tools.name: charts
tools.description: Roblox’s own charts (Top Earning, Top Trending, Up-and-Coming and the rest), as RoTerminal keeps them day by day in 60 countries and on every device. With no chart and no game: the list of charts, countries and devices. With a chart: its games now, each with its place yesterday, its move, its best p

tools.name: updates
tools.description: Every update of one Roblox game since tracking began (Sep 27 2026), newest first: when, its title, how many versions went out, players in the hours after it against the same hours a week before, and the change; also the typical change across its updates. Free and Plus see the last 10; Pro and Studio

tools.name: me
tools.description: The signed-in person’s own games (the ones My Games shows them): players now against usual for this time, the latest update and how players moved after it, and today’s alerts. Needs a free RoTerminal account: `roterminal login`.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
